name: Fluffy Badger
desc: An animal native to inland Snezhnaya, and a close relative of the Chic Badger.\nThe Fluffy Badger is covered in soft, thick, and long fur, allowing it to roam freely even in regions of extreme cold.\nDespite their fluffy appearance, their personalities are extremely fierce, and they never back down even when facing massive opponents. This is a rule of survival on the snowfields: do not carelessly set foot into a Fluffy Badger's territory, much less attempt to snatch food from their grasp. Otherwise, the Fluffy Badger will bare its Sharpened Claws, using swift strikes to deliver a heavy lesson to the offender.
